summary: Construct boxed recovery usage samples in the cgroup exit-sampling producer without changing payloads.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or shared writer changes.

rules.detail: INACTIVE: no production caller, boot hook or activation before 4c-2 and explicit activation. No policy defaults.

compatibility.detail: Keeper post-fork setup uses async-signal-safe operations, names the process fractal-keeper, closes inherited descriptors before readiness, and only pauses. Fresh direct children stay unreaped until placement verification or failed-placement cleanup completes, fencing their numeric PIDs. Only verified placement hands ownership to a reaper; no daemon pipe controls keeper lifetime.

manual.detail: Ignored fork/procfs fixtures check process name, detached session, descriptor closure, survival after adapter drop, and death after readiness remaining unreaped through failed-placement cleanup. Cargo, gate-slot proof and native execution not run.

recovery.detail: Sampling reports CgroupVanished only after ENOENT and confirmed absence of J. Permission, IO and non-directory errors remain ReadFailed, never fabricated disappearance or zero counters. Existing whole-J retirement ordering is retained.
